features.name: Full-grid prize
features.description: Filling all 25 positions awards the maximum win.

review:
Everything here revolves around a respin round on its own 5x5 grid. Three scatters swap the reels for a board where only money symbols and blanks land; money symbols stick, and each new one resets the counter to three.

The clever bit is group multipliers: connected money symbols form groups, and bigger groups get bigger multipliers (check the paytable for the exact steps). Filling all 25 spots pays the 10,000x max. Strong 96.58% RTP.
pros: Second route to big wins via respins or jackpots
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
